translation.Image-to-image switches to the edit endp: Image-to-image switches to the edit endpoint and is encoded as multipart files.
translation.Image-to-image stays on the same endpoin: Image-to-image stays on the same endpoint; image references travel in the JSON body and mask is not forwarded.
translation.Every entry keeps its own upstream in th: Every entry keeps its own upstream in the route table and requests are forwarded unchanged — the same behaviour as new-api. Turn the switch on to declare one address for all of them.
translation.Fold image entries into one canonical re: Fold image entries into one canonical request before sending.
Nothing is folded while this is off.
translation.Off: every entry forwards on its own rou: Off: every entry forwards on its own route, exactly like new-api.
translation.Primary endpoint must be a path starting: Primary endpoint must be a path starting with /.
translation.Responses keeps its own route. With the: Responses keeps its own route. With the image protocol on, chat entries are converted into image tasks, so keep that channel image-only.
translation.This endpoint is not an image path, so t: This endpoint is not an image path, so the protocol keeps folding image entries to /v1/images/generations; the other entries still forward here.
translation.This path does not end with generations,: This path does not end with generations, so image requests will not land where the protocol expects.
translation.The image protocol picks the endpoint it: The image protocol picks the endpoint itself; this entry does not use its own upstream.
translation.The shared landing address for every ent: The shared landing address for every entry. A single entry can still point somewhere else.
translation.Click to give this entry its own upstrea: Click to give this entry its own upstream.

translation.Image references stay in the JSON body;: Image references stay in the JSON body; mask is not forwarded.
Image and mask are uploaded as files.
translation.Left empty, the last segment of the prim: Left empty, the last segment of the primary endpoint is swapped from generations to edits. Fill it in only when the upstream path differs.
translation.Open the protocol details to change how: Open the protocol details to change how image-to-image reaches the upstream.

translation.How does the primary endpoint land upstr: How does the primary endpoint land upstream?
translation.Downstream entries only talk to this end: Downstream entries only talk to this endpoint; however many endpoints the upstream has, they all converge here.

translation.Not intercepted; keeps its own landing: Not intercepted; keeps its own landing
